Maya S. (sec): Heads-up: product wants to remove cluster-admin from private-deploy operator. We need an air-gapped plan for audit logs, keystore custody, and attestation artifacts.

Devon H. (infra): Agreed. Proposal: local signed audit bundles + optional scheduled push. If no push allowed, we produce a sealed bundle and an offline verifier.

Liu Z. (platform): Key custody options: (1) customer HSM (recommended), (2) wrapped key blob provided during on-site onboarding, (3) ephemeral software key with documented residual risk. We'll prefer TPM/SEV when available.

Nora P. (compliance): For attestation we need image digest, node quote, and the bundle head signature. Also a simple human-readable report for auditors.

Maya S. (sec): Can we make the audit format minimal and verifiable offline?

Liu Z. (platform): Yes. Each entry: ts, actor, action, prev_hash, sig. Bundle = daily tar.gz + head.sig + manifest.json. Verifier CLI will check chain continuity and signatures and emit JSON report.

Devon H. (infra): RBAC migration: create narrow ClusterRoles per operator-capability and a transition shim that logs any denied attempts. We'll run negative authz tests in CI (fail build if unexpected verbs used).

rbac-bot: rbac-lint report: branch `priv-operator-min` -> 2 exceptions flagged: `legacy-metrics:clusterrole`, `image-pruner:role`. Manual review required.

Nora P. (compliance): Evidence package should include: RBAC CI output, sealed bundles with verifier output, attestation artifacts, NetworkPolicy manifests and enforcement snapshot (conntrack or eBPF sample).

Maya S. (sec): Edge case: customer refuses any persistent key. We cannot produce long-term verifiable chains without keys. Proposal: offer "manual-anchor" mode: ephemeral keys + customer-signed root statement at install time and a documented acceptance of residual risk.

Liu Z. (platform): Implementation owners: Devon -> RBAC harness + rbac-bot integration (ETA 2w). I'll do auditchain sidecar + verifier (ETA 3w). Nora -> compliance pack template (ETA 1w).

Devon H. (infra): NetPolicy defaults: deny all egress from control-plane pods except local KMS proxy, NTP, and optional rsync collector. Provide maintenance-window token to allow scheduled uploads.

Maya S. (sec): OK. I'll write the SOC wording for key custody and the high-residual-risk checkbox. Filing tasks to SEC-1452. Thanks. :thumbsup:
